articles.title: FPIs resume selling; pull out Rs 7,443 cr from equities in first week of Sep
articles.content: September witnessed a notable outflow of Rs 7,443 crore from Indian equities as foreign investors retracted their investments, a stark contrast to the previous months' inflows. Contributing factors include increasing crude oil prices and robust US bond yields affecting investor confidence. Meanwhile, India's primary market still captivates foreign funds, showing resilience in attracting capital.
